**[P2] Store a weak invocation claim in the ContextVar**

This stores the plugin itself strongly in every claimed thread/task context. `unbind_invocation` can clear only its current context, so a long-lived worker claimed by an invocation retains the discarded plugin, spans, and context tokens indefinitely; it also prevents the `WeakSet` from cleaning up an invocation whose end hook never ran. Store a `weakref.ref` in the ContextVar and dereference it in `_resolve_provider`/`unbind_invocation`, with a test that keeps a claimed worker alive while confirming the ended plugin can be collected.
